manual: E-Elements hardware manual V1.2, user-supplied Scribd link
action: User pressed and released the physical central BTNC/S6 once
interpretation: Physical press and release delivered two GPIO interrupts; one press toggled LED from on to off. Main loop uses WFI, button is read only in ISR.
limits: One physical press/release verified. Not a ten-press endurance test. No QSPI/SD persistent boot image programmed. PCB silkscreen revision was not supplied.
